authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3471 keśa explicitly gives Nepali/Hindi kes and Gawri khẽs hair. The exact kes/keś family fits, with contact transmission unresolved. Exact survey form kẽs is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13574.3 sūriya explicitly lists Gawri sūrī, Kalasha sūri, Palula sūri and Shina sūri sun. These retained-r sūri forms select section 3; the different Maiya swīr form is placed under section 4 in Turner, so transmission into surveyed Maiya sūri remains open. Exact survey form sūrī is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
